subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB204
title: Directs the Department of Transportation to study issues related to driving privileges and to report to an appropriate committee or interim committee of the Legislative Assembly on or before September 15, 2026.
headline: SB 204 did not pass

claims.text: SB 204 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SB 204 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
